$note: Who vendors this package's built CSS, and where. A consumer that installs the package (MomentoMarks, a git dependency pinned by commit) is not listed: it resolves the package itself and cannot drift. A path that does not exist on this machine is skipped, not an error, so the build works on a CI runner with no siblings. Roots resolve against this repo's parent directory unless absolute; NFCCOOL_DESIGN_CONSUMER_ROOT overrides that parent. Sync UPDATES a vendored file that is already there and never creates one: a consumer adopts the package deliberately, with --adopt, not as a side effect of someone running a build.

business_card_service.why: Django, no npm at all: the built files are copied into its static folder and linked from the templates. dist/design-tokens.css is vendored on main since 2026-11-03: base_dashboard.html links it before dashboard.css, and the console's :root is aliases of these tokens, so a colour or radius the kit has is not typed in the console. dist/design.css is deliberately not vendored: the console still draws its components from its own dashboard.css, and the bundle would add 112 KB nothing reads. The store badges are vendored on main since 2026-10-13: the console's invite page shows them, and their PNGs since 2026-11-03: its mails do. Its mail shells extend dist/email/django/layout.html since then too, vendored as templates/nfccool_email/. dist/editor-kit.css and dist/editor-kit.js are the web block editor's parts (spec 2026-11-09): the stylesheet links in base_dashboard.html after dashboard.css and the script only on the editor page. They are adopted by copying into the feat/page-tab worktree, not with --adopt, and every build during that work runs with NFCCOOL_DESIGN_CONSUMER_ROOT on a folder holding a symlink to that worktree, because this entry's root is the main checkout. dist/image-crop.js, dist/slot-drop.js and dist/photo-tray.js are the console's own scripts, sourced here since then and copied unstamped, so the console's templates keep their paths. dist/board.css and dist/board-kit.js are the leads board (spec 2026-11-24-leads-board-design): both only on the leads list (its style block), not in base_dashboard.html: the board layer's generic .count would restyle the console's own pill awaiting count on Cards; adopted 2026-11-24 by copying.

keel.why: Keel's server (Vapor, no npm): the read-only status page at /status, reachable over Tailscale only, is recipe 1 assembled from the full bundle, served by Vapor's FileMiddleware from Server/Public/design. Adopted 2026-11-09 by copying the first three files byte for byte (no --adopt run, so no other consumer was touched). The App Store badge was added 2026-11-18 for the public licence link page (recipe 3), copied by hand the same way. The page's Titillium faces and the two nav logos are not built output, so they are copied from guideline/fonts and guideline/images by hand and are not listed here. ui.js was added 2026-11-18 for the licence page (confirm dialog, row menu, toast), copied by hand the same way. The transactional mail (dist/email/swift, plain {{name}} / {{{blocks}}} templates plus gaps.json, generated from the renderer by build/emit-email-swift.mjs) and its PNGs were added 2026-11-18 for the licence mails, copied by hand the same way; Keel fills them by string replacement. The licence pages' shell (recipe 1's side nav, recipe 3's plain bar: dist/shell/swift, generated from src/shell.js by build/emit-shell-swift.mjs) was added 2026-11-21, copied by hand the same way and bundled with the KeelServer target, which fills it with the mail's filler (KitShell); nav_account_link.html is not vendored, the licence page has no account page.
